# Load packages

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratWrappers)
library(tidyverse)
library(Biobase)
library(BiocGenerics)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(patchwork)
library(grid)
library(gridExtra)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(pheatmap)
library(viridis)
library(EnhancedVolcano)
library(scDblFinder)
```



# Read in the data

```{r, include=FALSE}
CTL_EC_data <- Read10X("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/scIntegration/data/data_muscle/data_Kim_scB16F10/CTL_EC_filtered_feature_bc_matrix")

CTL_nonEC_data <- Read10X("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/scIntegration/data/data_muscle/data_Kim_scB16F10/CTL_nonEC_filtered_feature_bc_matrix")

B16F10_EC_data <- Read10X("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/scIntegration/data/data_muscle/data_Kim_scB16F10/B16F10_EC_filtered_feature_bc_matrix")

B16F10_nonEC_data <- Read10X("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/scIntegration/data/data_muscle/data_Kim_scB16F10/B16F10_nonEC_filtered_feature_bc_matrix")
```

### NOTE - I am not using SoupX to remove ambient signals because all of the datasets were FACS sorted before hand (except Pryce et al. 2024 which was MACS sorted). This approach is stated in the McKellar codes. Pre-sorting removes a large amount of ambient signals. 



# Create Seurat Object

```{r, include=FALSE}
CTL_EC_seurat <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = CTL_EC_data, min.cells = 3, project = "Kim_scB16F10_CTL")
CTL_nonEC_seurat <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = CTL_nonEC_data, min.cells = 3, project = "Kim_scB16F10_CTL")
B16F10_EC_seurat <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = B16F10_EC_data, min.cells = 3, project = "Kim_scB16F10_B16F10")
B16F10_nonEC_seurat <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = B16F10_nonEC_data, min.cells = 3, project = "Kim_scB16F10_B16F10")
```



# 1. QC

## % mitochondrial reads

```{r, include=FALSE}
CTL_EC_seurat[["percent.mito"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(CTL_EC_seurat, pattern = "^mt-")
CTL_nonEC_seurat[["percent.mito"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(CTL_nonEC_seurat, pattern = "^mt-")
B16F10_EC_seurat[["percent.mito"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(B16F10_EC_seurat, pattern = "^mt-")
B16F10_nonEC_seurat[["percent.mito"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(B16F10_nonEC_seurat, pattern = "^mt-")
```



# 2. Filtering

```{r, include=FALSE}
CTL_EC_filtered <- subset(CTL_EC_seurat, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 60000 & nCount_RNA > 500 & nCount_RNA < 15000 & percent.mito < 10)
CTL_nonEC_filtered <- subset(CTL_nonEC_seurat, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 60000 & nCount_RNA > 500 & nCount_RNA < 15000 & percent.mito < 10)
B16F10_EC_filtered <- subset(B16F10_EC_seurat, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 60000 & nCount_RNA > 500 & nCount_RNA < 15000 & percent.mito < 10)
B16F10_nonEC_filtered <- subset(B16F10_nonEC_seurat, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 60000 & nCount_RNA > 500 & nCount_RNA < 15000 & percent.mito < 10)
```



# 3. Pre-process

```{r, include=FALSE}
all_genes_CTL_EC <- rownames(CTL_EC_filtered)
all_genes_CTL_nonEC <- rownames(CTL_nonEC_filtered)
all_genes_B16F10_EC <- rownames(B16F10_EC_filtered)
all_genes_B16F10_nonEC <- rownames(B16F10_nonEC_filtered)
```


## CTL_EC

```{r, include=FALSE}
CTL_EC_norm <- CTL_EC_filtered %>%
  NormalizeData(normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000) %>%
  FindVariableFeatures(selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000) %>%
  ScaleData(features = all_genes_CTL_EC) %>%
  RunPCA(npcs = 50)
```

```{r}
ElbowPlot(CTL_EC_norm, ndims = 50) ### to check dims
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
CTL_EC_norm <- CTL_EC_norm %>%
  FindNeighbors(dims = 1:41) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.1) %>%
  RunUMAP(dims = 1:41)
```


## CTL_nonEC

```{r, include=FALSE}
CTL_nonEC_norm <- CTL_nonEC_filtered %>%
  NormalizeData(normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000) %>%
  FindVariableFeatures(selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000) %>%
  ScaleData(features = all_genes_CTL_nonEC) %>%
  RunPCA(npcs = 50)
```

```{r}
ElbowPlot(CTL_nonEC_norm, ndims = 50) ### to check dims
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
CTL_nonEC_norm <- CTL_nonEC_norm %>%
  FindNeighbors(dims = 1:45) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.1) %>%
  RunUMAP(dims = 1:45)
```


## B16F10_EC

```{r, include=FALSE}
B16F10_EC_norm <- B16F10_EC_filtered %>%
  NormalizeData(normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000) %>%
  FindVariableFeatures(selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000) %>%
  ScaleData(features = all_genes_B16F10_EC) %>%
  RunPCA(npcs = 50)
```

```{r}
ElbowPlot(B16F10_EC_norm, ndims = 50) ### to check dims
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
B16F10_EC_norm <- B16F10_EC_norm %>%
  FindNeighbors(dims = 1:37) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.1) %>%
  RunUMAP(dims = 1:37)
```


## B16F10_nonEC

```{r, include=FALSE}
B16F10_nonEC_norm <- B16F10_nonEC_filtered %>%
  NormalizeData(normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000) %>%
  FindVariableFeatures(selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000) %>%
  ScaleData(features = all_genes_B16F10_nonEC) %>%
  RunPCA(npcs = 50)
```

```{r}
ElbowPlot(B16F10_nonEC_norm, ndims = 50) ### to check dims
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
B16F10_nonEC_norm <- B16F10_nonEC_norm %>%
  FindNeighbors(dims = 1:46) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.1) %>%
  RunUMAP(dims = 1:46)
```



# 4. scDblFinder

```{r, include=FALSE}
CTL_EC_dbl <- scDblFinder(GetAssayData(CTL_EC_norm, slot = "counts"), clusters = Idents(CTL_EC_norm))

CTL_EC_norm$scDblFinder.class <- CTL_EC_dbl$scDblFinder.class


CTL_nonEC_dbl <- scDblFinder(GetAssayData(CTL_nonEC_norm, slot = "counts"), clusters = Idents(CTL_nonEC_norm))

CTL_nonEC_norm$scDblFinder.class <- CTL_nonEC_dbl$scDblFinder.class


B16F10_EC_dbl <- scDblFinder(GetAssayData(B16F10_EC_norm, slot = "counts"), clusters = Idents(B16F10_EC_norm))

B16F10_EC_norm$scDblFinder.class <- B16F10_EC_dbl$scDblFinder.class


B16F10_nonEC_dbl <- scDblFinder(GetAssayData(B16F10_nonEC_norm, slot = "counts"), clusters = Idents(B16F10_nonEC_norm))

B16F10_nonEC_norm$scDblFinder.class <- B16F10_nonEC_dbl$scDblFinder.class
```


## See numbers of singlets vs. doublets

```{r}
table(CTL_EC_norm$scDblFinder.class)
table(CTL_nonEC_norm$scDblFinder.class)
table(B16F10_EC_norm$scDblFinder.class)
table(B16F10_nonEC_norm$scDblFinder.class)
```


## Remove Doublets

```{r, include=FALSE}
CTL_EC_singlets <- subset(CTL_EC_norm, subset = scDblFinder.class == "singlet")

CTL_nonEC_singlets <- subset(CTL_nonEC_norm, subset = scDblFinder.class == "singlet")

B16F10_EC_singlets <- subset(B16F10_EC_norm, subset = scDblFinder.class == "singlet")

B16F10_nonEC_singlets <- subset(B16F10_nonEC_norm, subset = scDblFinder.class == "singlet")
```



# 5. Combine conditions

## Merge data

```{r, include=FALSE}
ordered_datasets <- c(CTL_EC_singlets, CTL_nonEC_singlets, B16F10_EC_singlets, B16F10_nonEC_singlets)

features_merge <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = ordered_datasets)
```


## Find anchors

```{r, include=FALSE}
anchors_merge <- FindIntegrationAnchors(object.list = list(CTL_EC_singlets, CTL_nonEC_singlets, B16F10_EC_singlets, B16F10_nonEC_singlets), anchor.features = features_merge)
```


## Combine data

```{r, include=FALSE}
Kim_scB16F10 <- IntegrateData(anchorset = anchors_merge)

DefaultAssay(Kim_scB16F10) <- "integrated"
```


## Remove unused objects to improve processing

```{r, include=FALSE}
rm(anchors_merge, CTL_EC_data, CTL_EC_dbl, CTL_EC_filtered, CTL_EC_norm, CTL_EC_seurat, CTL_EC_singlets, CTL_nonEC_data, CTL_nonEC_dbl, CTL_nonEC_filtered, CTL_nonEC_norm, CTL_nonEC_seurat, CTL_nonEC_singlets, B16F10_EC_data, B16F10_EC_dbl, B16F10_EC_filtered, B16F10_EC_norm, B16F10_EC_seurat, B16F10_EC_singlets, B16F10_nonEC_data, B16F10_nonEC_dbl, B16F10_nonEC_filtered, B16F10_nonEC_norm, B16F10_nonEC_seurat, B16F10_nonEC_singlets, ordered_datasets, all_genes_CTL_EC, all_genes_CTL_nonEC, all_genes_B16F10_EC, all_genes_B16F10_nonEC, features_merge)
```
